decisions.reason: The message defines the Lead Clipper selection and responsibilities but does not change the current 15-to-20-clip qualification trial or its success condition.
The message does not change the permitted source content; its instruction to begin creating clips does not establish a different source-selection rule.
The message directs the freelancer to consult brand guidelines but does not modify the existing standard for selecting strong source moments.
Mentioning that the Notion guidelines cover editing style does not itself establish a change to the existing clean-editing requirement.
